name: paabox-mcp

tools.name: harvest_paa
tools.description:
Unpack Google's "People Also Ask" (PAA) box for a search query, several levels deep, using the PAA Box Chrome extension in the user's own Chrome. Searches run as the user (their Google session, language and location), not from a server.

Returns a nested Markdown outline of every question found (depth 0 = the questions Google shows first; each deeper level = the new questions that appear after opening a question), followed by the full JSON question set. The JSON includes a harvest "id" for get_harvest and build_aka_plan. Every harvest is also saved in PAA Box, so list_harvests finds it later.

Choosing depth and mode (typical times):
- mode "fast" (questions only): depth 0 ~5s, depth 1 ~10s, depth 2 ~30s, depth 3 ~1-2 min.
- mode "full" (questions plus each answer snippet and source URL): depth 0 ~30s, depth 1 ~1 min, depth 2 ~4 min, depth 3 ~12 min.
Google usually shows about 4 questions at depth 0, and each deeper level multiplies the count. Default to fast mode at depth 1 or 2. Use full mode only when the user needs answers or sources, and tell them how long it will take.

"full" mode needs a visible browser window: PAA Box opens a Chrome window and works in it, so the user will see it and should leave it open until the harvest finishes. "fast" mode does not need one.

Rate limits, enforced by PAA Box to protect the user's Google account: at least 20 seconds between harvests and at most 30 per hour. A call that breaks either fails with rate_limited and says how long to wait. Don't harvest the same query twice; reuse results with list_harvests and get_harvest. If Google shows a CAPTCHA the harvest fails with captcha, and the user has to solve it in Chrome. Harvests stop after 15 minutes.

Needs the PAA Box extension with a Pro plan, "Allow AI assistants (MCP)" turned on in the PAA Box panel, and Chrome open. Call paabox_status if unsure.

query.description: The search query as a person would type it into Google, for example "plumber chicago".

depth.description: How many levels to unpack, 0-3. 0 = only the questions Google shows first. 1 (default) = also the questions revealed by opening each of those. 2 and 3 go further; each level multiplies the question count and the time.

mode.description: "fast" (default): questions only. "full": also each answer snippet and source URL; much slower and needs a visible Chrome window.

google_domain.description: Google domain to search, for results from another country, e.g. "www.google.co.uk". Default "www.google.com".

tools.name: list_harvests
tools.description: List the harvests saved in the user's PAA Box extension, most recent first: id, query, Google domain, depth, mode, question count and time. Use it before harvest_paa to reuse an earlier harvest instead of spending time and rate limit on a repeat, and to find ids for get_harvest and build_aka_plan. Quick: it reads PAA Box's saved data and does not search Google.

limit.description: How many harvests to return, 1-100. Default 20.

query.description: Only return harvests whose original query matches this text (for example "plumber").

tools.name: get_harvest
tools.description: Get one saved harvest by id: every question with its depth (and, for full-mode harvests, its answer and source URL) as a nested Markdown outline, followed by the JSON question set. Reads PAA Box's saved data. It does not search Google again and does not count toward the harvest rate limit.

id.description: Harvest id, from harvest_paa or list_harvests.

tools.name: build_aka_plan
tools.description:
Turn a saved harvest into an AKA content plan. PAA Box builds it inside the user's browser from the question structure (rule-based, no AI call), so nothing leaves the computer. AKA has three page types:
- Authority: broad pillar pages that own the main topic.
- Knowledge: supporting pages that go deep on one subtopic.
- Answer: short pages that each answer one specific question.
Each page has a title, a URL slug, a primary question, the other questions it should cover, and parent_slug, which links it to its parent page in the site structure. Returns the plan as Authority, Knowledge and Answer sections, followed by the JSON plan.

PAA Box Pro only (otherwise fails with not_pro). Does not search Google.

id.description: Harvest id, from harvest_paa or list_harvests.

tools.name: paabox_status
tools.description: Check whether paabox-mcp can reach PAA Box: whether the local bridge is running and on which port, whether the extension is connected, and its version and Pro status. Never fails. Call it when another PAA Box tool reports a connection problem, or before a long harvest.

instructions:
PAA Box tools unpack Google's People Also Ask questions through the PAA Box Chrome extension, in the user's own Chrome.
- Default to harvest_paa in fast mode at depth 1 or 2. Use full mode (answers and sources) only when the user wants them; it is much slower and opens a visible Chrome window.
- Check list_harvests before harvesting a query again. Harvests are rate limited: 20 seconds apart, 30 per hour.
- If a tool says PAA Box is not connected, pass the setup steps on to the user. paabox_status shows the connection state and never fails.
